title: corymbia erythrophloia
intro: Corymbia erythrophloia, commonly known as Red Ironbark, is a species of tree native to eastern Australia. This tree is valued for its timber, which is highly prized for its durability and resistance to decay. The Red Ironbark tree is also known for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant are thought to include phenolic compounds and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
